card.name: Next item in a numbered sequence
card.fires_on: The marked word or digit that continues a running sequence, such as the next list letter, ordinal, or number in a table or series. It sits at the point where the next step in the order is expected.

modes.label: List and ordinal steps
modes.description: A list letter, list number or ordinal that follows the previous one in an ordered list or dose schedule.

modes.label: Digits in number series
modes.description: A digit inside a table of evenly increasing numbers.

modes.label: Repeated words
modes.description: A word in a long run of the same word repeated.
